contentHtml:
Credits

Lead Designer: James Wyatt

Designers: Jeremy Crawford, Makenzie De Armas, Ron Lundeen, Ben Petrisor, Patrick Renie

Rules Developers: Makenzie De Armas (lead), Jeremy Crawford, Ron Lundeen, Ben Petrisor, Carl Sibley

Editors: Adrian Ng (lead), Judy Bauer, Sue Weinlein

Playtest Analysts: Ron Lundeen (lead), Makenzie De Armas

Art Director: Noor Rahman

Graphic Designers: Matt Cole, Paolo Vacala

Cover Illustrators: Michael Broussard, Patrick Gañas

Interior Illustrators: Ignacio Bazan-Lazcano, Michael Broussard, Cullen Cole, Daarken, Andrea De Dominicis, Kevin Gnutzmans, John Grello, Yinfaowei Harrison, Michal Ivan, Jordan Kerbow, Kuno, Arthur Loftis, Calder Moore, Lee Moyer, Claudio Pozas, Noor Rahman, Dave Sarabia, Leroy Steinmann, John Thacker, Kenny Vo, Esther Wu, Ahmed Zulfiqar

Cartographer: Sean Macdonald

Concept Artists: Michael Broussard, John Grello, Alexander Ostrowski, Noor Rahman

Consultants: Keith Baker, Elizabeth Banerjee, Shawn Banerjee, Daniel Delgado, Sameer Joseph

Producers: Rob Hawkey (lead), Bill Benham, Siera Bruggeman, Vanessa Hoskins

The following products provided information and inspiration:

Baker, Keith, Michelle Lyons, Ari Marmell, and C.A. Suleiman. Dragonmarked. 2006.

Baker, Keith, Bill Slavicsek, and James Wyatt. Eberron Campaign Setting. 2004.

Baker, Keith and James Wyatt. Sharn: City of Towers. 2004.

Crawford, Jeremy. Tasha’s Cauldron of Everything. 2020.

Crawford, Jeremy, Keith Baker, and James Wyatt. Eberron: Rising from the Last War. 2019.

Noonan, David, Frank Brunner, and Rich Burlew. Explorer’s Handbook. 2005.

Noonan, David, Ari Marmell, and Robert J. Schwalb. Eberron Player’s Guide. 2009.

Wyatt, James, Keith Baker, Luke Johnson, and Stan! Player’s Guide to Eberron. 2006.

Wyatt, James, Keith Baker, Ari Marmell, and Robert J. Schwalb. Eberron Campaign Guide. 2009.

An Artificer is hard at work creating a warforged in the forges of House Cannith in this piece by Michael Broussard.

Patrick Gañas shows us the completion of the process, as the Artificer brings the newly created warforged soldier out of the creation forge and into life.
